title: Quality Analyst
desc: Job Summary: We’re seeking a Quality Analyst (2–3 years exp.) to design and execute test strategies for scalable web applications and APIs. title: Quality Assurance Engineer, Prime Video Sports
desc: Love sports? Want to change the world? Every day we face the challenges of a fast-paced market and expanding technology set. And we're building at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded-owner, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling new experiences to our customers. If this sounds like the type of experience you'd like to help build - apply here and let's chat! Who we are: We are deeply connected with the idea that live sports events are fundamentally different: there is only one shot at delivering the moment until it is forever lost. Our mission is to make sure that our customers never miss a single moment of the sports they love. To do this we need to deliver best-in-class live sports infrastructure, testing, monitoring, and operations to optimize the delivery of live sports experiences at scale. Our team engineers for speed, quality, availability, and scale. As Prime Video has grown, we've increased the depth and breadth of video products we support, with a corresponding increase in the associated size and complexity of our engineering activity and the load on our services. Our goal is to adapt our architecture to maintain and improve our velocity of delivery for customers in the face of these changes, and for our services to be on and error-free 24/7, especially for high-profile, exclusive content. With AI as a transformative force, we're at an inflection point that enables us to unlock new opportunities in predictive analytics, automated defect analysis and mitigation, and automated operations that were previously beyond our reach. What we're looking for: We are looking for an experienced QA engineer to drive manual and automated testing within Prime Video Sports across a broad technology stack. This role involves deep involvement on projects from design to development & deployment. In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to the future of the Prime Video Sports customer experience. Successful candidates for this position demonstrate ability to multi-task, quickly adapt to new development environments and changing business requirements, learn new systems, create reliable/maintainable automated tests, find creative and scalable solutions to difficult problems, and ability to communicate clearly and concisely both written and orally. If you are the one that’s excited about entrepreneurial thinking, creating technology solutions for complex problems we want to hear from you. What you will do here: You will work with groups such as Product Management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. You will also work with Software Development Engineers to understand features and technical implementation. In this role, you will be responsible to deliver manual/automated solutions to test customer facing features. You will be empowered to choose the right highly scalable and available technology to solve complex problems in software quality assurance. What you will get from us: A great team to work with and the chance to build at a proven top tier company. You will get a startup like culture with the stability of an established industry leader. You will get support and resources from some of the smartest people in the industry to continue learning. Key job responsibilities 1. Test Planning and Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive test plans for new features and product releases. 2. Bug Identification and Resolution: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify, document, and resolve software defects. 3. Automation tooling: Develop, extend, and maintain automated tests on iOS, Android, Web, and Living Room Clients to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. 4. Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure a seamless integration of quality throughout the development lifecycle. 5. title: Quality Assurance Engineer II, Alexa Connectivity Devices
desc: Are you passionate about building reliable, high-quality software that customers can depend on? As a Quality Assurance Engineer II at Amazon, you will play a critical role in ensuring our products meet the highest quality standards before they reach customers. You will design and execute comprehensive test strategies, build automation that scales, and collaborate closely with engineering teams to catch defects early and prevent them from happening in the first place. This is a hands-on role where your analytical mindset and technical skills will directly influence product quality. You will own test planning for complex features and services, write automated test cases that provide meaningful end-to-end coverage, and drive continuous improvements to how we measure and deliver quality. If you are a self-starter who thrives on solving problems and making systems more reliable, we want to hear from you. Key job responsibilities Own end-to-end test strategy for device software features and wireless connectivity — defining what to test, how to test it, and what lab infrastructure is needed, even when requirements are ambiguous or evolving across kernel, firmware, and RF domains. Create and execute test plans for complex test scenarios including system integration, wireless protocol conformance (Wi-Fi, BLE, Zigbee, Thread, Matter, Sidewalk), power profiling, and hardware-software co-validation across firmware, OS, and connectivity boundaries. Design and build Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test rigs and automated test solutions that are maintainable, reusable, and reliable — enabling other engineers to run and extend them independently against real device hardware. Develop RF test automation scripts for wireless performance benchmarking, packet error rate measurement, sensitivity testing, and production line calibration support. Own power profiling and battery life testing — current measurement, sleep/wake analysis, duty cycle optimization validation using tools such as Nordic PPK2 or Keysight power analyzers. Create and maintain protocol conformance test suites for Wi-Fi Alliance, Zigbee Alliance, CSA Matter, and Amazon Sidewalk certification requirements. Build regression test infrastructure that runs on every CI/CD build against real hardware targets, integrated with the team's Yocto-based build pipeline. Isolate, document, and validate defects with detailed evidence and root-cause analysis across embedded software, wireless stacks, and peripheral interfaces (SPI, I²C, UART), enabling development teams to triage and resolve issues efficiently. Represent quality assurance in cross-functional discussions including design reviews, release readiness decisions, and retrospectives — advocating for quality at every stage of the device software development lifecycle. Support regulatory pre-certification testing (FCC, CE, BIS, TELEC) for wireless subsystems and device platforms. Mentor junior engineers, interns, and contractors — training them on device platforms, test methodologies, and lab tools, and creating documentation that reduces tribal knowledge. Proactively identify quality risks, propose solutions, and take on projects that improve testing processes or more accurately measure product quality across the full device software stack. A day in the life You will start your day reviewing test results from overnight automation runs, triaging any new defects and identifying root causes. From there, you might join a design review to assess the testability of an upcoming feature, then shift to writing or refining automated test cases for a current release. You will regularly partner with software engineers and product managers to align on quality priorities and participate in bug triage sessions. Expect to mentor teammates, contribute to retrospectives, and continuously look for ways to make testing smarter and more efficient. About the team The Alexa Connected Devices Device Software team is a new two-pizza team in Bangalore, India, supporting device software development for Amazon's connected devices portfolio. The team brings deep expertise in operating system fundamentals, embedded systems, wireless connectivity (Wi-Fi, BLE), and sub-gigahertz standards (Zigbee, Thread, Matter, Amazon Sidewalk). We are growing and looking for curious, technically strong people who want to make a real impact on how connected device technology serves customers worldwide. - 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience - Experience in manual testing - Experience in automation testing - Experience scripting or coding - Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects - Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium - Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality - Experience troubleshooting and debugging embedded systems, wireless connectivity stacks, and firmware - Experience developing high-quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution for IoT device platforms - Experience with test management tools (e.g., TestRail, Zephyr) and issue management tools (Jira) - Experience working closely with embedded software, hardware, and wireless engineering teams to communicate problem impacts and understand technical requirements Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. desc: Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners. At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation. Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do. We are looking for a skilled Quality Assurance Engineer specialising in Network Access Control (NAC) and network security to join our engineering team. In this role, you will own test methodologies, design comprehensive test plans, and push our software and hardware to their limits to ensure enterprise-grade reliability and security. Who You'll Work With: You will collaborate closely with a tight-knit engineering group. You will partner with Software Developers and Architects from the earliest functional specification and design review stages to embed quality and customer-centric thinking directly into the product. Alongside top-tier Linux Platform Engineers, you will work in a high-velocity environment designed to accelerate development cycles without compromising stability. You will also team up with Cross-Functional QA and Automation Peers to align your hands-on exploratory testing insights with developer-led test automation frameworks. What You’ll Do Work with the developers on your team in creating their plans for automated tests to complement the exploratory testing that you perform. Participate in functional specification and software design reviews held by your team and provide customer centric input. Work in a highly productive environment alongside top engineers on the Linux platform, cutting typical development cycles by an order of magnitude with a laser focus towards quality. Use every means possible to find the bugs in the software and/or hardware being developed by your team Write test plans to validate Arista features and products. Design test network topologies to validate the functionality, performance, stability and scalability of features and products. Execute test plans to verify all aspects of the product. Identify defects and validate resolution. Work as an agile member of a combined development and test team, running in short cycles to develop functional software in quick iterations. 5–7 years of experience in networking, with a focus on network access and security. Strong candidates with fewer years will be considered. Proven ability to develop test methodologies, write test plans, and execute structured test campaigns across functional, regression, and integration testing. Strong knowledge of network access protocols and technologies: 802.1X, RADIUS, TACACS+, AAA, NAC, VLANs, IP routing, TCP/IP, L2/L3 protocols, and Wi-Fi. Hands-on experience configuring wired switches and wireless access points from multiple vendors (Cisco, Aruba, Juniper/Mist) for network access use cases. Experience with EAP methods (EAP-TLS, PEAP/MSCHAPv2, EAP-TEAP) and certificate-based authentication. Familiarity with identity providers such as Okta, Azure Active Directory, OneLogin, or LDAP/Active Directory environments is a plus. Experience testing cloud-native SaaS applications is a plus. Experience with MDM/EDR platforms (JAMF, Intune, CrowdStrike) and their integration with NAC solutions is a plus. Prior experience with AAA or NAC products is a plus. Familiarity with automation frameworks and scripting (Python, Go, or similar) for test automation is a plus. Experience with troubleshooting packet captures (Wireshark) and RADIUS debug logs is a plus. Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.
